counter_definition.state: One rejected tracking state or unsplit transient-grid entry, counted when it first fails a checked boundary. This is not the number of originally emitted particles.
counter_definition.storage: One rejected call to a residual storage method; this is distinct from the state counter and must not be summed into a particle count.

behavior_on_rejection: Use the existing REMOVE_PARTICLE path for tracked states.
Preserve receptor contributions that were valid before the rejected state.
Skip a non-finite residual write and preserve its destination cell.
Discard the untracked remainder without zero replacement, redistribution or replay.
Report a nonzero long counter after both drivers finish a weather situation; no output for zero.
remaining_limits: This is not an input-validation or mass-balance-repair framework.
Finite but out-of-domain coordinates, invalid cell sizes and source-group indices remain subject to the existing indexing preconditions.
The state guard does not generally validate AHint, all meteorological globals, dry-deposition Pd1, wet drift data or conversion factors.
Non-finite shared deposition/receptor/concentration sums caused by otherwise finite arithmetic are not repaired; only residual storage increment and sum overflow are checked by the storage patch.
Already polluted arrays are not recovered and earlier contributions are not rolled back.
Zero, negative finite values, signed zero and subnormals are accepted; this patch does not impose positivity or minimum time-step policies.
RNG arithmetic, Box-Muller endpoint expressions and ignored Clamp return values are unchanged. Endpoint component evidence does not measure real-run occurrence rate.
Injected component cases prove the selected rejection paths, not the frequency or field-science accuracy effect of NaN failures.
The extracted branch fixtures are separate from actual initial-driver and storage DLL calls; they are not full Main fault-injection runs.

reconstruction.method: Apply exact LF unified diff to fresh warning-free baseline files, then verify every source byte SHA against the frozen manifest.
